The '''A-rack''' was a type of small military carrier which resembled a wheeled A-frame, with a center-mounted engine and an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] for defense. They were used by the [[Empire of the Hand]] and in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Empire deployed three A-racks during an [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], against the combined forces of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the battle, the A-racks were used to carry three [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] into the [[Red City]] on Quethold, where the stormtroopers engaged a large number of [[Quesoth Soldier]]s.
